issues.description: Checklist item 1 gives a concrete mapping example ('postup = rukopis, výsledek = text') but no explicit citation in the provided excerpts supports that specific mapping. While the general definition of multimodalita and the OneNote/Minecraft examples are supported, the recommended one‑to‑one mapping is an author recommendation rather than a citationable fact.
issues.required_fix: Either add a supporting citation (if available) for that mapping, rephrase the sentence as general background advice (label it 'general background knowledge'), or remove the specific mapping example.

issues.description: The section recommends collecting artefacts (scans/OneNote exports/Minecraft worlds) but does not instruct teachers about safe storage/format or link to privacy/GDPR guidance in the manual. Given earlier chapters cover privacy (chapter 2.2 etc.), this omission may lead to inconsistent practices.
issues.required_fix: Add a short sentence directing teachers to specify upload location and acceptable file formats (e.g., LMS, PDF/PNG/OneNote export) and cross‑reference the privacy/DPIA guidance (chapter 2.2 / 2.2.4) so that collectors of student artefacts follow GDPR‑aware procedures.

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: In the first paragraph consider making the definitional sentence explicitly cite the KB (already present) and keep as-is. No change required unless you want to add a short cross‑reference to section 5.2.4 in the outline (which already defines multimodalita).
Fix the LaTeX typo: replace '\textit{Las o}' with '\textit{Laso}'. Keep the rest of the instruction, which matches the KB excerpt (kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_04e4a115_page_13_2).

Add one sentence with practical upload/format guidance and a privacy cross‑reference. Suggested wording for the author to adapt: 'Uveďte v zadání, kam studenti mají artefakty nahrát (např. LMS), preferované formáty (PDF/PNG/OneNote export) a krátkou poznámku o ochraně osobních údajů — viz sekce 2.2 Ochrana soukromí a návrh DPIA.' This links the recommendation to existing material on privacy.

Either remove the concrete example mapping ('např. postup = rukopis, výsledek = text') or mark it as 'general background knowledge / practical tip' (not a sourced fact). If you keep it, consider adding a phrase 'doporučená praxe' or similar to make it clear it's an author suggestion rather than an evidence‑backed claim.

Add brief, concrete examples of acceptable file types and a reminder to check storage/retention policy. Example: 'Uveďte preferované formáty (PDF, PNG, OneNote export) a kam je nahrát; zvažte retenci a přístupová práva v souladu se sekcí 2.2 (GDPR).' This improves actionability for teachers.
